XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Rear tailgate opening inactive, electric soft top automatic system not working
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | SYSTEM | SOFT TOP | ELECTRIC | AUTOMATIC | TAILGATE | BOOT | BUTTON | REMOTE CONTROL | KEY | OPENS | FAILURE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Vehicles equipped with electric hood

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Electric bonnet system

  • Fault: Opening of the boot via remote control and button on the tailgate inactive. The electric bonnet mechanism is inactive, but using the dedicated button, the bonnet opens and closes normally.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Incorrect learning of electric soft top mechanism

• Task: Program the electric soft top

  • Procedure: To programme the electric soft top, follow these steps:
    • Get into the car and ensure the boot, doors and bonnet are properly closed
    • Locate the electric soft-top opening and closing buttons, situated on the right-hand and left-hand sides respectively, near the rear-view mirror and the interior light.
    • Switch on the instrument panel
    • Press the soft-top opening button, wait for it to open fully, and hold the button down for a further 5 seconds
    • Press the soft-top closing button, wait for it to close fully, and hold the button down for a further 5 seconds
    • Procedure complete
    • Once complete, the soft top will open automatically halfway
